name: Clinical Consultation
description: General outpatient consultations, minor procedures and clinic registration for adults and children.

name: Laboratory Services
description: Diagnostic blood, urine, stool and body-fluid tests, plus blood grouping and transfusion services.

name: Radiology Department
description: X-ray, ultrasound and contrast imaging studies.

name: Pharmacy Services
description: Dispensing of medicines, IV fluids, injections and medical supplies.

name: Nutrition Services
description: Nutrition assessment and review, plus therapeutic and supplementary feeds.

name: Inpatient Services
description: Admission, accommodation, nursing care and in-ward procedures for admitted patients, including maternity care.

name: Surgery
description: General, orthopaedic, neuro, urological, ENT, eye, gynaecological and reconstructive surgical procedures.

name: Dental Services
description: Dental examination, extractions, fillings, scaling, dentures, root canal and oral surgery.

name: Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT)
description: Diagnosis and treatment of ear, nose, throat and neck conditions, including hearing assessment.

name: Ophthalmology
description: Eye examination, treatment and eye surgery.

name: Rehabilitation and Physiotherapy
description: Physiotherapy, occupational therapy, splints, assistive devices and rehabilitation.

name: Orthopedics
description: Fracture and dislocation management, plaster of Paris (POP) casts, traction, splints and mobility aids.

name: Urology and Dialysis
description: Haemodialysis and urological care, including catheter services and the renal clinic.

name: Other Specialist Services
description: Psychiatry, cardiology, obstetrics and gynaecology, and gastroenterology specialist services.

name: Emergency and Casualty Services
description: Emergency medical and casualty treatment services.
